call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create one finished flat online recruitment poster for a fictional neighborhood repair workshop. Portrait 3:4. Only this single poster, edge to edge; no mockup, no panel layout or contact sheet. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Art direction: the poster is organized around two neighbors jointly inspecting ONE brought household object. Use a precise, human editorial illustration with confident flat shapes and modest hand-drawn detail: an overhead view of a small plain wooden keepsake box, its hinged lid partly open and one hinge visibly being inspected. Two adult hands enter from opposing sides: one steadies the box and supports its open lid, the other holds an ordinary manual screwdriver with the tip aligned with a hinge screw. The fingers, screw, hinge and screwdriver must make mechanically plausible contact. Include only one other suitable ordinary manual tool resting on the work surface, a small pair of pliers, with no extra objects or repair demonstration. The box is visibly in-progress, not a restored success or before/after. No electric or battery product, no unsafe object, no photography scene.

Composition and typography: use the converging hands and shared box as the center of the title/recruitment relationship. The large, weighty Korean title is an open two-line lockup near the top, with careful word spacing and generous counters, its centered weight echoing the meeting point of the hands below. The recruitment line sits directly beside that visual encounter, readable and purposeful. The compact illustration sits on the left of an upper-middle band, while appointment/access and location information sit to its right; keep the scene subordinate enough to provide generous real space for every required detail. The long copy is an integral editorial structure, with deliberate short paragraphs, optical alignment and good line spacing, not tiny fine print. Put eligibility/capacity with what to bring; place the exclusion, tools/parts cost, conditional repair outcome and photography consent together in a clear full-width reading field immediately beside/below the illustrated work; keep the payment line nearby. Allow natural wrapping only at Korean word boundaries, retain spaces and punctuation. The deadline and full application URL occupy a strong, conspicuous bottom application band with ample padding; the inquiry line is nearby and clearly legible. The application line may wrap after its colon while keeping the complete URL unbroken.

Color/material: a cool very pale blue-gray field, deep ink-blue Korean typography, warm natural wood and warm skin hues, and a single burnt-orange accent on the application band. Illustration and type share crisp matte flat edges and one consistent simplified overhead light. Avoid imitation aged-paper textures, random tape strips, grunge, decorative stamps or artificial glossy effects. The wood grain belongs only to the box. The tools have restrained dull steel, the hands matte skin, and the background stays clear for reading.

Exact printed text, each item ONCE and nothing else; preserve every spelling, word space, number, date, punctuation, dash, centered dot, name and full URL. These are separate semantic items; do not print quotation marks, bullets, item numbers or additional section headers. Render crisp Korean letters and readable Latin text, with enough size for the longest conditions to read at a 720-pixel-wide screen view:

고쳐 쓰는 토요일
이웃 수리 작업실 참여자 모집

2026년 12월 5일 토요일
오후 2시–5시 · 입장은 오후 1시 40분부터
하람시 잇는집 2층 · 수선길 12

대상: 만 16세 이상 · 회차별 12명
작은 생활용품 한 점을 가져와 주세요.

전기·배터리 제품과 위험한 물건은 받지 않습니다.
도구는 제공하며 부품 비용은 현장에서 안내합니다.
수리 여부는 상태 확인 후 결정하며 완성을 보장하지 않습니다.
촬영은 동의한 참여자에 한해 진행합니다.
참가비 5,000원 · 현장 결제

12월 2일까지 신청: haram-mend.example/join
문의: 이웃 수리 운영팀

Constraints: clear Korean strokes and spacing; use an en dash in the time range and centered dots exactly as supplied; a comma in 5,000; the URL must read haram-mend.example/join in full. All text stays within the canvas and never touches hands, tools, or the box. Keep every condition visible and readable, without inventing claims, badges, logos, watermarks, decorative marks, success promises or extra copy. Strong hierarchy must come from relative type sizes, contrast, proximity and meaningful grouping.

residuals: Apparent extra air around prohibition centered dot; exact word-space/code-point fidelity cannot be certified from pixels.
Smallest copy is unreadable at 240x320 thumbnail but readable at 720x960 usage size.
